verdict.rationale: Salv documents backtesting: you can run a draft screening flow or monitoring scenario version against up to a year of your own history and see which alerts it would have raised or what it would have caught. That is a first-party way to gauge detection behaviour. Auto-closed alerts from clearance rules also stay on the record, so incorrect clearances could be reviewed. However, nothing describes scoring against labelled validation cases or measuring detection-quality or false-clearance rates. Missing for 10: labelled validation or ground-truth case sets, detection-quality metrics (e.g. precision/recall or missed-detection rates), measurement of incorrect clearances or auto-closures, independent corroboration.
